ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the given food web diagram, which animal acts only as prey?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web is labeled with cattails plant, mosquito, leopard frog, earthworm, spotted salamander, blue gill fish, shrew, northern copperbelly water snake, great egret. The arrows indicate food/prey pointing to the eater/predator. In the diagram, cattails plant points to mosquito and earthworm; earthworm also has arrows pointing to spotted salamander and shrew, indicating that earthworm is eaten by these animals. Reasoning: To find the animal that is “only prey,” one should look for an animal that is eaten by other animals, but is not shown preying on other animals. earthworm is only connected with plants as a food source and is eaten by spotted salamander, shrew, etc., and it is not shown preying on other animals. Therefore the answer is earthworm.
